provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 672 S KOWALD LN, NEW BRAUNFELS, TX, 78130

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The Children's Product Certification wasn't available for review.  This was corrected when the director printed the form and signed it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the video and interviews, a name to face was not conducted upon entering the classroom which led a child to be left unsupervised in the hallway of the building for approximately 10 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Based on the interviews and videos, the 2-year-old room was over ratio by 4 in the morning.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: Two out of five children were missing parent signatures for Epi pens.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: Two types of medication was found to be expired.  This was corrected when the medication was put away to give back to the parent .
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: No Smoking or Use of Tobacco Including E-Cigarettes or Vaporizers: Based on the information gathered, a caregiver entered the facility with a vape pen in her shirt pocket.  The pen fell out of her shirt resulting in a toddler picking it up and putting it in the mouth. It was retrieved quickly from the caregiver. NOTE: The caregiver with the vape pen was terminated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Smoking or Use of Tobacco Including E-Cigarettes or Vaporizers (26 TAC §746.3703(d))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months: A teacher was observed feeding two infants without holding them.  The two infants were observed on the floor mat being fed.  This was corrected when the teacher held the infant to feed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months (26 TAC §746.2419(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the video and interviews conducted, two children were left in the classroom unsupervised for approximately 5 minutes when the caregiver walked out of the classroom with another child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The last health inspection was conducted on 4-17-2024 which makes it past due.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The last fire inspection was conducted on 4-11-2024 which is past due.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the video and interviews conducted, a staff did not conduct a name to face before walking outside in front of the children allowing the classroom door to shut.  This resulted in a child being left in the classroom unsupervised for approximately 4 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: Two forms of medication were expired.  This was corrected when the director disposed of the medication.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The plastic containers in two rooms that hold toys were damaged, leaving rough edges that could pose a risk to children.  This was corrected when the containers were removed.     A few rooms had torn diaper changing mats were the foam was exposed. This was corrected when the mats were removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the video and interviews conducted, two staff did not conduct a name to face while lining the children up to go inside from the playground and when entering the room to ensure all children were accounted for.  The staff did not do a sweep of the playground.  This resulted in a child being left outside on the playground unsupervised for approximately 9 minutes until another class came outside and found the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: A caregiver was heard yelling at the children while she was changing a child's diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening/Closing: Based on interviews and daily attendance infants 12 months and older were being combined in the morning with children ages 18 months and older in the first 45 minutes of opening.  Child/caregiver ratios cannot be adjusted during opening and closing for children who are younger than 18 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening/Closing (26 TAC §746.1615)

occurrences.finding: Policies for Release of Children: A person listed on a child?s enrollment form picks up a child without being verified at the front entrance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies for Release of Children (26 TAC §746.4103(a))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: The operation admitted to not informing a parent of an incident that occurred at the center immediately that placed a child at risk until they were able to find out what happened from the caregivers and video.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the video and interviews conducted, two staff did not conduct a name to face while lining the children up to go inside from the playground and when entering the room to ensure all children were accounted for.  This resulted in a child being left outside of the classroom door unsupervised for approximately 2 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: During snack, the children were served sliced cucumbers, ranch dressing and water, which only meets one of the three required components that must be included per the USDA Nutritional Guidelines.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The last fire drill was conducted in December of 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based upon evidence collected during this investigation, it was determined that a caregiver left a child who was using the restroom alone in a classroom unsupervised, while the caregiver was assisting a parent outside the classroom.  This resulted in a child being left in the classroom unsupervised for approximately four minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: The parent was not notified immediately when a child was left in a classroom unsupervised for approximately 4 minutes.  The parent was notified the next morning about the incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based upon the evidence collected during the investigation, two children were playing on a piece of equipment in the classroom incorrectly with three caregivers in the room which resulted in one child having to receive medical care due to the equipment tipping over.  It was determined through interviews/video that the caregivers responded adequately and professionally after an injury occurred to a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Securely Anchored: Based upon the evidence collected during this investigation, a piece of equipment in the classroom was not properly secured according to the manufacturing guidelines.  This resulted in the equipment tipping over on a child causing an injury.  The center was proactive by bolting the play equipment against the wall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Securely Anchored (26 TAC §746.4601(5))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the video and interviews conducted, two staff did not conduct a name to face while lining the children up to go inside from the playground and when entering the room to ensure all children were accounted for.  This resulted in a child being left outside of the classroom door unsupervised for approximately 3 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: Two dump trucks on the playground were broken and were sharp to the touch which could cause an injury to a child.  This was corrected when the trucks were disposed of.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the interviews conducted and video obtained, an infant teacher was observed in a rocking chair falling asleep while holding an infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Medication Records - Name of Employee Who Administered: The medication form did not have the employee's first and last name on the form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Records - Name of Employee Who Administered (26 TAC §746.3805(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The Children's Product Certification wasn't available for review.  This was corrected when the director printed the form and signed it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Five out of ten employees were missing a required affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance: Based on the video, it was determined that positive methods of discipline were not used when a caregiver yanked a child several times by one arm as the child was upset after morning drop off and was trying to walk away as the caregiver was talking to her.  The caregiver was seen tossing the child inside of a tent area that had pillows located in the room.  Note:  The operation immediately terminated the caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Parts of the Plan of Action was not being followed.  There were no observations in classrooms or outside for the month of November.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Several bottles in the infant room were not labeled with the child's first name and last initial.  This was corrected when the provider labeled them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Three infants were missing an updated feeding instruction.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: Two different incidents happened at the operation where the children had to seek medical care.  The first incident happened on 8-5-2022 and the second incident on 9-12-2022.  These two reports were not reported to licensing until 9-20-2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Based on the video, a caregiver was seen sitting on her bottom with her legs crossed on the playground while approximately (12) 3-year-olds were running around and some playing on the playscape.  A 3-year-old was bumped by another child while one was going down and the other one was coming up the stairs of the playscape resulting in the 3-year-old falling through an opening and landing wrong on her arm fracturing it in several places.  The caregiver did not see the incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: A child was injured while at the daycare and sought medical attention on September 1 and the daycare did not report the incident to Licensing until September 8 which is past the 48 hours required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Not Under the Influence of Alcohol or Controlled Substance: Based on the interviews conducted, a caregiver arrived to work under the influence of a Controlled Substance.  The caregiver was never in the room alone with the children and was terminated from the job immediately that morning by management.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Not Under the Influence of Alcohol or Controlled Substance (26 TAC §746.3703(c))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: A 12-month-old climbed up on the table during snack time and as he was trying to get back down, he fell hitting his head and bruising the lower part of his back.  The two caregivers in the room at the time did not see what happened so the video was watched.  The operation was pro-active by having the caregivers do some training before returning to work.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Must Keep Hand on Child: A caregiver walked away from a diaper changing table twice with a 14-month-old on it to tend to a child who got off his mat during nap time.  The 14-month-old was not injured.  The caregiver was terminated by the operation for her actions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Must Keep Hand on Child (26 TAC §746.3503(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: Three out of ten children's records were missing the statement of special needs.  This was corrected when the director was able to get the parent to fill it in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: A maintenance active playground checklist was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A staff that was hired was in a classroom without receiving the eligibility notifications from the background check unit.  This was corrected when the assistant director had the person leave the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Several rooms did not have the cleaning bottles marked and they were empty and not ready for use.   This was corrected when a staff prepared the bottles and labeled them for the rooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))
